summary_1line: After killing the cursed deer, Pandu renounces worldly life, vows severe asceticism with Kunti and Madri, gives away his wealth, and withdraws to the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pandu, grief-stricken in the forest beside Kunti and Madri, raises his hands while declaring his vow to renounce the world.
The king removes his crown jewel and ornaments and gives them to Brahmanas before sending his attendants back to Hastinapura.
Servants weep with tears streaming down their faces as they leave Pandu and his queens alone in the forest.
